audience: small business owners and accountants who keep their books in Merit Aktiva

useCases.title: Find which customers still owe money
useCases.text: The AI reads open customer receivables with date, due date, total, paid and unpaid amount per document, and can keep only documents overdue by a number of days.

useCases.title: List the sales invoices of a period
useCases.text: The AI lists sales invoices for a period of up to 3 months, finds them by number or customer, and reads one in full with its lines and VAT.

useCases.title: Check vendor bills and whether they are paid
useCases.text: The AI lists purchase invoices for a period with vendor, totals and paid flag, reads one bill, and searches vendors.

useCases.title: Read the profit and loss and the balance sheet
useCases.text: The AI reads the income statement and balance sheet with balances per month, and sums up the main changes.

useCases.title: Review payments and bank account movements
useCases.text: The AI lists customer and vendor payments of a period and the income or expense payments booked on a bank account, with the documents they paid.

useCases.title: Look up a customer or add a new one
useCases.text: The AI searches customers by name, registry number or VAT number and creates a new customer. It never overwrites an existing customer.
